title: Noisy influence bounded by influence
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a $\pm 1$-valued Boolean function, let $i\in[n]$ be a coordinate, and let $\rho$ be a noise rate with $0<\rho\le 1$. Then the noisy influence of $i$ on $f$ at rate $\rho$ is at most the ordinary influence of $i$ on $f$:
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i^{\rho}[f]\;=\;\sum_{S\ni i}\rho^{\abs{S}-1}\,\hat f(S)^2\;\le\;\mathrm{Inf}_i[f].
\]
replaced:
For a $\pm 1$-valued $f$ and $0 < \rho \le 1$, the noisy influence of any coordinate
is at most its ordinary influence:
$\mathrm{Inf}_i^{\rho}[f] \le \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$.
